name: Stranger Things
_comment: A theme is pure looks. Copy this file, change the numbers, drop it in themes/, and it joins the T / pad-Y rotation. Colors are [R, G, B], 0-255.

window._comment: The size this theme is DESIGNED at. The picker scales fonts, padding, border and glow by however much your actual window differs from it, so these are proportions as much as pixels.

font._comment: First family installed on the machine wins. name_size is the big name, small_size the footer line.

glow._comment: Bloom behind the winning name. Off: the name renders crisp. Set enabled true (with a radius) to bring the halo back.

background._comment: Lighting behind the name. gradient false = flat fill of bg_bottom. spotlight is a soft pool of light in the middle (spread is a multiple of the window size). rays are drifting vertical light bands; motes are slow floating specks. Speeds and widths are fractions of the window, so they stay right at any size. Turn any of them off with enabled: false.

footer._comment: Show the 'N of M left' counter under the name.
